rules.title: Your home folder
rules.what: Everything that belongs to your user account: documents, app data, settings.

rules.title: Your Library folder (hidden)
rules.what: The hidden folder where macOS and every app keep their settings, data and caches. Most of the space macOS calls 'System Data' lives here.
rules.if_removed: Every app would lose its data and settings.

rules.title: App caches
rules.what: Temporary files apps keep to load faster: web data, thumbnails, downloaded updates.
rules.if_removed: Apps rebuild what they need. The first launch may be slower. Quit the app first.

rules.title: macOS caches
rules.what: Caches used by macOS services (Spotlight, Safari, Siri...). macOS manages and trims them itself.
rules.if_removed: Usually harmless but little benefit; macOS may recreate them immediately.

rules.title: Leftover app-update downloads
rules.owner: Electron apps (VS Code, Cursor, Claude, Slack...)
rules.what: Copies of app updates downloaded by the app's auto-updater. Often left behind after the update is installed.
rules.if_removed: Nothing. The app downloads the next update when needed.

rules.title: Homebrew download cache
rules.what: Package downloads Homebrew keeps after installing.
rules.if_removed: Nothing; Homebrew downloads again when needed.
rules.how: brew cleanup --prune=all

rules.title: pip download cache
rules.what: Python packages pip downloaded before.
rules.how: pip cache purge

rules.title: Playwright browsers
rules.what: Chromium/Firefox/WebKit builds used by Playwright tests.
rules.if_removed: Tests fail until you run `npx playwright install` again.

rules.title: Browser cache
rules.what: Cached web pages and images.
rules.if_removed: Sites load a little slower the first time. You stay logged in.

rules.title: Claude app cache
rules.what: Cache files of the Claude desktop app / Claude Code.

rules.title: Docker Desktop cache
rules.what: Docker Desktop's own cache (not your images).

rules.title: Logs
rules.what: Diagnostic text files apps write while running, and crash reports.
rules.if_removed: Nothing you'd notice. Only useful for troubleshooting.

rules.title: Application Support
rules.what: Where apps keep their real data: databases, downloaded content, profiles, chat histories.

rules.title: Data for one app
rules.owner: The app named in the folder
rules.what: Data belonging to the app in the folder name. If that app is uninstalled, this is a leftover and can go.
rules.if_removed: If the app is still installed it may lose settings, logins or downloaded content.

rules.title: Claude task sandbox
rules.what: The Linux virtual machine Claude uses to run tasks on your computer.
rules.if_removed: Claude re-downloads it (~10 GB) the next time it needs it.

rules.title: Claude web cache
rules.what: Browser-style cache of the Claude app.

rules.title: Claude local task sessions
rules.what: Working files of past tasks Claude ran on this computer.
rules.if_removed: Old task sessions lose their local files.

rules.title: App web cache
rules.what: Cache of an app built on web technology (Slack, Teams, VS Code, Cursor, Discord...).
rules.if_removed: Rebuilt automatically. Quit the app first.

rules.title: Editor per-project data
rules.what: One folder per project you ever opened: editor state, search index, and (in Cursor) AI chat history.
rules.if_removed: Projects open fresh: tabs, local history and chats for those projects are lost.

rules.title: Editor local file history
rules.what: Automatic backups of every file version you saved.
rules.if_removed: You lose the editor's 'Local History' timeline.

rules.title: Browser profile
rules.what: Bookmarks, saved passwords, history, extensions.
rules.how: Clear browsing data from inside the browser.

rules.title: iPhone / iPad backups
rules.what: Full local backups of your iPhone or iPad. Often 10-100 GB each.
rules.if_removed: You can't restore your device from these backups.
rules.how: Finder > your device > Manage Backups to delete old ones, or move them to an external drive.

rules.title: Steam games
rules.what: Installed games.
rules.how: Uninstall games in Steam, or add a library folder on an external drive.

rules.title: GarageBand / Logic sound library
rules.what: Instruments and loops. Several GB, unused if you don't make music.
rules.how: GarageBand > Sound Library > uninstall, or delete with admin rights.

rules.title: App containers
rules.what: Private data folders for App Store and sandboxed apps.

rules.title: Sandboxed app data
rules.owner: The app in the folder name
rules.what: Private data of one sandboxed app.
rules.if_removed: That app loses its data. Leftover only if the app is uninstalled.

rules.title: Apple app data
rules.what: Data of a built-in Apple app.
rules.if_removed: That Apple app loses data. macOS usually blocks this anyway.

rules.title: Sandboxed app cache
rules.what: Cache inside a sandboxed app's container.

rules.title: Docker Desktop
rules.what: Docker's Linux VM, including the disk that holds all images, containers and volumes.
rules.if_removed: All images, containers and volumes are gone.
rules.how: docker system prune -a   (or Docker > Settings > Resources > Disk image location to put it on an external drive)

rules.title: Docker disk image
rules.what: The virtual disk with every Docker image, container and volume. It shows as 1 TB but only uses what is written.
rules.if_removed: Docker starts empty: all images, containers and volumes (databases!) are deleted. Quit Docker first.
rules.how: Prefer `docker system prune -a` to keep volumes.

rules.title: Group containers
rules.what: Data an app shares with its widgets and extensions (WhatsApp media, Office, Notes...).

rules.title: Shared app data
rules.owner: The app in the folder name
rules.what: Data shared between an app and its extensions.
rules.if_removed: That app loses data. Leftover only if the app is uninstalled.

rules.title: WhatsApp chats and media
rules.what: Every photo, video, voice note and document from your WhatsApp chats.
rules.if_removed: Chats and media disappear from this Mac.
rules.how: WhatsApp > Settings > Storage and data > Manage storage. Turn off media auto-download.

rules.title: Microsoft Office / Teams data
rules.what: Shared data for Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams and OneDrive.
rules.if_removed: Office apps may lose settings, fonts or offline mail.

rules.title: Siri voices
rules.what: Downloaded Siri and spoken-content voices.
rules.how: System Settings > Accessibility > Spoken Content > System voice > Manage Voices

rules.title: Apple Mail
rules.what: Your emails and attachments downloaded by Apple Mail.
rules.if_removed: Local mail and anything not on the server is lost.
rules.how: Remove unused accounts in Mail, or turn off 'Download attachments'.

rules.title: Messages history
rules.what: iMessage/SMS history and every photo or video sent to you.
rules.how: Messages > Settings > General > Keep messages: 1 Year. Or Settings > Storage > Messages to review large attachments.

rules.title: Keychains (passwords)
rules.what: Your saved passwords, certificates and keys.

rules.title: App settings
rules.what: Small settings files (.plist) for each app. Rarely large.

rules.title: iCloud Drive (local copies)
rules.what: Files from iCloud Drive that are downloaded to this Mac.
rules.if_removed: Deleting here deletes from iCloud too!
rules.how: System Settings > Apple Account > iCloud > Optimise Mac Storage, or right-click a file > Remove Download.

rules.title: Cloud drives (Dropbox, OneDrive, Google Drive)
rules.what: Local copies of cloud drive files.
rules.if_removed: Deleting here may delete from the cloud too.
rules.how: Right-click > Free up space / Make online-only.

rules.title: Photos library
rules.what: Your photo library. Never move files out of it by hand.
rules.if_removed: Photos are lost or the library is corrupted.
rules.how: To move it: quit Photos, drag the whole library to the external drive, open it with Option held. Or turn on iCloud Photos > Optimise Mac Storage.

rules.title: macOS learning and Siri data
rules.what: On-device data macOS uses for Siri, suggestions, Spotlight and Apple Intelligence.
rules.if_removed: macOS rebuilds it, possibly breaking suggestions meanwhile.

rules.title: Saved window state
rules.what: Which windows each app had open.
rules.if_removed: Apps reopen without restoring old windows.

rules.title: Web data used by apps
rules.what: Cookies and web storage of apps.

rules.title: Xcode and developer data
rules.what: Build products, simulators, device symbols and archives from Xcode and other Apple developer tools. Open it to see which parts are safe.
rules.if_removed: Depends on the part: build caches rebuild, simulators and archives don't.

rules.title: Xcode build products
rules.what: Intermediate build files.

rules.title: Xcode device support files
rules.what: Debug symbols copied from every iOS version you connected.

rules.title: Xcode archives
rules.what: Builds you archived for App Store / TestFlight.
rules.if_removed: You lose debug symbols for those releases.

rules.title: iOS simulators
rules.what: Simulator devices and their data.
rules.how: xcrun simctl delete unavailable

rules.title: pnpm package store
rules.what: Every npm package pnpm has downloaded, shared between projects.
rules.if_removed: Projects re-download packages on next install.
rules.how: pnpm store prune

rules.title: Python user packages
rules.what: Packages installed with `pip install --user`.

rules.title: Bin
rules.what: Files you already deleted. They still use space until the Bin is emptied.
rules.how: Finder > Empty Bin

rules.title: npm cache
rules.what: Packages npm/npx downloaded.
rules.how: npm cache clean --force

rules.title: Developer tool caches
rules.what: Caches of command-line tools (uv, pip, Hugging Face, Puppeteer...).
rules.if_removed: Tools download again; some (AI models) are large.

rules.title: uv package cache
rules.what: Python packages cached by uv.
rules.how: uv cache clean

rules.title: Hugging Face models
rules.what: AI models and datasets downloaded by transformers/diffusers.
rules.if_removed: Models download again (can be many GB).
rules.how: Set HF_HOME to a folder on an external drive.

rules.title: Ollama models
rules.what: Local LLMs you pulled with Ollama.
rules.how: ollama list / ollama rm <model>. Set OLLAMA_MODELS to use an external drive.

rules.title: Codex app runtime
rules.what: Node/Python runtimes and plugins the Codex app downloads to run tools.
rules.if_removed: Codex downloads them again the next time it needs them. Quit Codex first.

rules.title: LM Studio models
rules.what: Local LLMs downloaded in LM Studio.
rules.how: LM Studio > My Models > change the models folder to an external drive.

rules.title: LM Studio engines
rules.what: llama.cpp / MLX runtimes LM Studio downloaded.
rules.if_removed: LM Studio downloads them again on next use.

rules.title: Gradle cache
rules.what: Java/Android dependencies and Gradle versions.

rules.title: Maven repository
rules.what: Java dependencies.

rules.title: Rust crate cache
rules.what: Downloaded Rust crates.

rules.title: Rust toolchains
rules.what: Installed Rust compiler versions.
rules.how: rustup toolchain list / rustup toolchain uninstall <name>

rules.title: Node.js versions (nvm)
rules.what: Every Node.js version installed with nvm.
rules.if_removed: Projects needing that version break until reinstalled.
rules.how: nvm ls / nvm uninstall <version>

rules.title: Python versions (pyenv)
rules.what: Python versions installed with pyenv.
rules.how: pyenv uninstall <version>

rules.title: Conda package cache
rules.what: Downloaded conda packages kept after install.
rules.how: conda clean -a

rules.title: Editor extensions
rules.what: Installed extensions. Updates often leave old versions behind.
rules.how: Remove unused extensions in the editor; old version folders are safe to delete.

rules.title: Android emulators
rules.what: Emulator disk images (several GB each).
rules.how: Android Studio > Device Manager

rules.title: SSH / GPG keys
rules.what: Your private keys.
rules.if_removed: You lose access to servers and signing keys.

rules.title: Global npm tools
rules.what: Command-line tools installed with `npm install -g`, one folder per tool.
rules.if_removed: That command stops working. Uninstall with npm so its links are removed too.
rules.how: npm ls -g --depth=0   then   npm uninstall -g <name>

rules.title: JavaScript dependencies
rules.what: Packages installed for one project.
rules.if_removed: Run `npm install` (or pnpm/yarn) in the project to get them back.

rules.title: Python virtual environment
rules.what: Packages installed for one Python project.
rules.if_removed: Recreate: python3 -m venv .venv && pip install -r requirements.txt

rules.title: Build / tool cache
rules.what: Regenerated automatically by the tool.

rules.title: Terraform providers
rules.what: Provider plugins downloaded for one Terraform project.

rules.title: Git history
rules.what: The full history of a project.
rules.if_removed: Unpushed commits and history are lost.

rules.title: Desktop
rules.what: Files on your desktop.

rules.title: Documents
rules.what: Your documents.

rules.title: Downloads
rules.what: Everything you downloaded.

rules.title: Your files
rules.what: Something you created or saved. Only you know if it's still needed.

rules.title: A download
rules.what: Something you downloaded. Old downloads are often no longer needed.
rules.if_removed: Lost unless you can download it again.

rules.title: Installer
rules.what: An installer or disk image. Once the app is installed it isn't needed.
rules.if_removed: Download it again if you ever need to reinstall.

rules.title: Archive
rules.what: A compressed file. Often already unpacked somewhere else.
rules.if_removed: Lost unless you have the unpacked copy.

rules.title: Video
rules.what: A video file. Videos are the easiest big win to move to an external drive.

rules.title: Final Cut / iMovie library
rules.what: A video editing library, including render and proxy files.
rules.how: In Final Cut: File > Delete Generated Library Files. Move whole libraries only as one bundle.

rules.title: Applications
rules.what: Installed apps.

rules.title: Installed app
rules.what: An application. Remove it if you no longer use it, then remove its leftovers in Library.
rules.if_removed: The app is uninstalled. Its data in Library stays until removed.

rules.title: Built-in Apple app
rules.what: Part of macOS.

rules.title: System-wide Library
rules.what: Data shared by all users: drivers, fonts, app support, updates.

rules.title: System-wide app data
rules.what: Shared data for apps and drivers. Changing it needs admin rights.

rules.title: System caches and logs
rules.what: System-wide caches and logs.
rules.if_removed: Rebuilt by macOS. Needs admin rights.

rules.title: Downloaded macOS updates
rules.what: Updates waiting to be installed.
rules.how: Install the update in System Settings > General > Software Update.

rules.title: Xcode Command Line Tools
rules.what: git, clang, make and the macOS SDK.
rules.if_removed: Developer tools (git, Homebrew builds) stop working.

rules.title: Homebrew
rules.what: Everything installed with `brew install`.
rules.how: brew cleanup --prune=all && brew autoremove

rules.title: Homebrew package
rules.what: One Homebrew formula (possibly several versions). It may be a dependency of another package.
rules.how: brew uses --installed <name>   then   brew uninstall <name>

rules.title: Homebrew cask
rules.what: An app or SDK installed with `brew install --cask`.
rules.how: brew uninstall --cask <name>

rules.title: /usr/local
rules.what: Software installed outside the App Store.

rules.title: Swap and sleep image
rules.what: Memory macOS moved to disk. Grows when RAM is full.
rules.how: Quit heavy apps or restart to shrink it.

rules.title: Temporary files
rules.what: Per-user temporary files and caches ($TMPDIR).
rules.how: Restart the Mac; macOS clears it.

rules.title: System databases
rules.what: Spotlight, security and system databases.

rules.title: System logs
rules.what: System log files.

rules.title: macOS
rules.what: The operating system. Sealed and read-only.

rules.title: Shared folder
rules.what: Files shared between user accounts; some installers drop content here.
